name: Angie's Restaurant (Logan) All-Day Diced Ham & Egg Scramble, Sourdough Toast & Pancakes
whyItWorks: Served all day on Main Street: fluffy scrambled eggs with diced lean ham, cheddar cheese, and buttermilk pancakes or toasted sourdough bread.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Angie's Scramble (eggs, diced ham, and cheddar only—no onions, peppers, or salsa) with sourdough toast or pancakes instead of greasy hash browns.
watchOuts: Avoid the Santa Fe Scramble (peppers, onions, and salsa)
Take a Lactaid for buttermilk pancakes
